pages.text: The Stack Upgrade increases the amount of items that can be transferred at once. Each upgrade installed will multiply the transfer amount.
Features:$(li)Increases item transfer amounts$(li)Can be stacked for greater effect$(li)Works in machines like Importers, Exporters, and Constructors$(li)Increases power consumption
To use the Stack Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption
